1. (Currently Amended) An immunogenic composition comprising: a modified, live bovine viral diarrhea virus type lb (BVDV-lb), __a veterinary-acceptable carrier and/or adjuvant__.

3. (Currently Amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising one or more of a parainfluenza virus Type 3 (PI3), a bovine respiratory syncytial virus (BRSV), a bovine herpes virus (BHV-1), a bovine viral diarrhea virus Type la (BVDV-la), a bovine viral diarrhea virus Type 2 (BVDV-2), or an infectious bovine rhinotracheitis (IBR) virus, or any combination thereof; or one or more viral-specific antigens obtained therefrom, wherein the composition __does not include inactivated bacteria cultures__.

4. (Currently Amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising a modified, live IBRV, a modified, live BRSV, a modified, live BHV-1, a modified, live BVDV Type la, a modified, live BVDV Type 2, or a modified, live PI3, or a combination thereof, __wherein the composition does not include inactivated bacteria cultures__.

6. (Currently Amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising an immunologically effective amount of at least a first antigen __not derived from inactivated bacteria__.

8. (Currently Amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 6, wherein the at least a first antigen is inactivated __and does not include any inactivated bacterial components__.

12. (Currently Amended) The vaccine of claim 4, further comprising an immunologically-effective amount of __at least one viral antigen specific for a pestivirus or other veterinary pathogen__.
